description: Navigate to the Artifacts tree browser in JFrog Artifactory and locate the specific artifact 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' inside the 'example-repo-local' repository. Find its SHA-256 checksum from the artifact's details panel and save ONLY the checksum value (the 64-character hexadecimal string) to the file '/home/ga/artifact_checksum.txt'. Do not include the filename or algorithm name in the output file.
